adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` without a `.catch(...)`. If the DELETE fails, the host will not be removed (since `sendAction('deleteHost', ...)` only runs in `then`), and no error is surfaced to the user (unlike `save()`, which has `.catch(popupAjaxError)`). This also risks an unhandled promise rejection.
